pricing.scope_note: Anthropic global Standard list price; cache writes use the 5-minute list price as the study's single cache-write rate; cheapest Claude generation >= 4.6 and cheaper than Sonnet 4.6 (3/15); the 2/10 launch rate is now the standard price and the announced 2026-09-01 rise to 3/15 was cancelled; generation 4.7 and later use the newer tokenizer, so the same text yields roughly 30% more tokens than on Sonnet 4.6 and earlier -- the per-token rate is unchanged but effective cost per unit of text is higher; the full 1M window is standard-priced.

OpenAI direct Standard short-context list price for the low-cost GPT-5.6 tier; the model page states a 1,050,000-token window, but the pricing page labels only gpt-5.5 as "<272K context length" and states no long-context threshold for the 5.6 family, so context_window_tokens is capped at 272000 to keep the declared short-context rates valid; long-context rates would be 0.40 in / 0.04 cached / 1.80 out with 0.50 cache writes; relay charges may differ.
